decisions.reason: Although submarine interior lighting is relatively distant and still niche, the firm's maritime customer base, engineering capabilities and organisational slack make management likely to keep it on the market longer while learning about demand.

A medical examination light builds on the firm's established lighting know-how and quality reputation, so without clear evidence of performance below aspiration there is little reason for management to withdraw it quickly.

Industrial explosion-proof luminaires fit the firm's industrial customer base and certification-heavy technical strengths especially well, making this product line unlikely to be dropped within a year.
The designer task light is close to the existing offer and was relaunched as a popular product, so past acceptance and low strategic risk would lead management to retain it.
